params.name: auto_radius
params.description:
Increment search radius until enough results are provided (specified by 'page[limit]' parameter.)
Max radius is 1000 miles. (default false)

params.name: renter_age
params.description: Minimum renter age required for rental

params.name: page[limit]
params.description: Limit the number of results (default 25, max 150)

params.name: page[offset]
params.description: Skip some results and return results starting with this offset (min 0, max 1000)

params.name: date[from]
params.description: Date from, for date range query, e.g. 2021-06-01

params.name: date[to]
params.description: Date to, for date range query, e.g. 2021-06-14

params.name: near
params.description: Latitude,longitude to search near, e.g. "38.302,-121.972". Supersedes address. Superseded by bounding box.

params.name: address
params.description:
Street address to search near. Superseded by latitude/longitude and by bounding box.
If no `address` is passed, GeoIP is used to get geo coordinates.

params.name: delivery_address
params.description: Street address to be delivered to. Supersedes `address` field. Default radius 100 miles

params.name: near_rental
params.description:
Rental ID to search near, e.g. 37183. Superseded by bounding box.
Specified rental is boosted to be at the top of the results.

params.name: hidden
params.description: Show hidden results? (Non-hidden results will not be returned.)

params.description: Only return results with scores greater or equal than this

params.description: Only return results with unlimited generator hours? Boolean string

params.description: Only return results with insurance requiring driver verification? Boolean string

params.description: Distance unit for location search requests

items.docs: Search performs search on rentals
GetHomepageRecomendationRentals finds for homepage based on passed rental tag

SearchMinimal performs search on rentals with a limited subset of
options, returning a minimal payload. This is generally intended for use in
3rd party products that need a subset of data to display a link to a rental.
For example, iterable wants to show name, image, type, city and state as a
link in an email.
